Import Data

Upload a Volza Excel export to update every view, filter and chart.

Prototype built from FRD v2 (Trade Data Automation & AI Analytics Platform). Until a file is imported, figures are generated sample data shaped to the Volza schema; they are not real market numbers. Imported files are read in the browser and stay on this device. Excluded rows (used machines, spares, consumables, Additive < USD 2,000) are kept in the raw store and never counted here.
